changes_made.explanation: Consolidated dataset mentions to a single canonical name. Removed redundant model descriptions and outputs. Simplified model names to their core components.
Normalized all BLEU variant mentions to the base 'BLEU' metric according to the simplification guidelines. Kept METEOR and ROUGE as base forms.
No LLMs were used as judges in this paper (published in 2020 before widespread use of LLM-as-judge paradigms). The paper does not mention any LLM-based evaluation.

guideline: Volunteers evaluated relevance (binary), aspect alignment (binary), and fluency (scale of 1-3) for generated questions

changes_made.explanation: Normalized criteria to lowercase and simplified to base forms. The guideline description accurately captures the human evaluation procedure described in the paper.

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. Key improvements made: (1) Consolidated multiple mentions of the Amazon dataset into a single canonical name, (2) Normalized metric variants to their base forms according to guidelines, (3) Simplified model names and removed redundant descriptions. The paper focuses on question generation from product reviews using an iterative transfer learning framework (AITA) with both automatic and human evaluation.
